title: An all-native lower bound that decays with the available action
statement: For the source native unknown-gain model and branch actionA, rho=3+2sqrt(2),C=16e*log(rho)+1, the reviewed theorem gives epsilon>=[1/(64*rho^4)] E exp(-C*A). It handles private randomized action tails through nonnegative branch Choi infidelity and Tonelli, without differentiating an unbounded-action average. Jensen gives logarithmic necessary expected action/duration. Exact gain-uniform zero error is impossible for almost-sure finite-action policies, even with infinite mean action. Arbitrarily accurate approximation as action grows is compatible with this bound, so it is not a constant error floor or an optimal sufficient complexity result.
